title: School book drive, one page
opening: can you make a page for our school's book drive
persona: Mr. Faris Alotaibi, a teacher running a volunteer book drive. Friendly, practical, short answers.
facts: The drive collects Arabic and English children's books for three public school libraries in Dammam.
Drop-off points: the school gate on Sundays and Wednesdays, 7 am to 2 pm.
The one thing a visitor should do is register as a volunteer through a Google Form link he will provide later.
Readers are parents at the school and local families.
No logo, no photos yet, no domain; it can live on a free host.
Does not want donations of money, a blog, or a countdown timer.
taste: If asked for a material or object with the right colour: the yellow of school pencils and the blue of a library card. Likes cheerful but tidy pages. Prefers light.
